NLS INSTALLATION 
MANUAL 
1.When you are installing or using the software, you need to close all the Anti-Virus 
software first. 
2.After installed, you can go to the setting of anti-virus software and find the Exclusions 
section, add the NLS software to an Exclusions list. Then the antivirus software won't 
bother you anymore. (Actually, there is no virus in the software, because our software is 
encrypted and the anti-virus consider it is virus. ) 
3.Use the USB cable connect the NLS device to your computer. 
 
 

4.Insert the flash disk into your computer. 
 
5. Double click the Setup file. 
6. Click Next > 
7. Don’ t change the installation folder, Click Next > 
Without light is a Dongle. 
When you install the software and using the 
software, this Dongle need to be always 
inserted to your computer. It’ s a key to use 
this device. 
With Red light is a Flash disk for installing. 

8. Click Install, then Finish. 
9. The Bio-inductor need to be worn on your ear and cover your ear well, don’ t have any 
obvious leakage from it, because the bright light will affect the result or suddenly stop 
scanning.
